name: ReverseChain
purpose: Public LKSystem namespace architecture lineage and restore reference chain

chain.source: LKSystem namespace architecture manual plus PhantomCapsule README.md
chain.note: Formal namespace architecture keeps a single system root, a single root node, and a single formal container. Search is restored as the 11th formal action while tool and platform names are not promoted into the system tree.

chain.source: NAMESPACE.json added as capsule self-describing namespace declaration
chain.note: NAMESPACE.json introduces xmlns: LKSystem://PhantomCapsule — the SVG xmlns analog for PhantomCapsule. A capsule carrying this file can explain its own existence without an external interpreter. Public template set updated from 六件套 to 七件套.

chain.source: PROTOCOL.json added as formal LKSystem:// protocol definition
chain.note: LKSystem:// is formally defined as the system's own protocol scheme. PROTOCOL.json declares the URI table (LKSystem://LKMINI, LKSystem://PhantomCapsule, LKSystem://Entry/Welcome, LKSystem://Exit/RealDelivery), the mapping rule (dot to slash), and usage rules. Public template set updated from 七件套 to 八件套.

chain.source: 🌸真善美模式 formal identity standard — LKMINI:// root protocol and metadata_sha256 anchored
chain.note: Correction: LKMINI:// is the 唯一正式根協議 (formal root protocol); LKSystem:// is the 命名空間定址協議 (namespace addressing protocol). PROTOCOL.json updated to define both. LOCATOR.json and NAMESPACE.json updated with root_protocol=LKMINI://, lkmini_metadata_sha256=412aabdb5985e8237be94a96204bad5abfa94c6e1de5ffd83077e465e85b84e3. Root chain completed with 🪪身分｜Ident as final node.

chain.source: System-wide capsule migration — all repos mapped and migration guide created
chain.note: WORLD_MAP.json added: maps all 7 LKSystem capsules (LKSystem.Seed private, LKSystem.LKMINI, LKSystem.PhantomCapsule, LKSystem.Entry.Welcome, LKSystem.Tools, LKSystem.Ledger, LKSystem.Guardian) with migration priority, status, and cross-capsule reverse chain. CAPSULE_MIGRATION.md added: per-repo NAMESPACE.json templates and migration checklists for all remaining capsules. Private repo lkminiPhantomWorld/- identified as LKSystem.Seed — the autonomous semantic civilization loop source whose 6 properties (self-preserving, self-describing, self-verifying, self-contextualizing, self-accounting, self-framing) are the philosophical foundation of the PhantomCapsule format itself. A=A: one system, one root, all capsules return to LKMINI://.
